20:       #

24:       #

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks against comparing a variable with multiple items, where
      # `Array#include?`, `Set#include?` or a `case` could be used instead
      # to avoid code repetition.
      # It accepts comparisons of multiple method calls to avoid unnecessary method calls
      # by default. It can be configured by `AllowMethodComparison` option.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b' || a == 'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   a = 'a'
      #   foo if ['a', 'b', 'c'].include?(a)
      #
      #   VALUES = Set['a', 'b', 'c'].freeze
      #   # elsewhere...
      #   foo if VALUES.include?(a)
      #
      #   case foo
      #   when 'a', 'b', 'c' then foo
      #   # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # accepted (but consider `case` as above)
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: true (default)
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      # @example AllowMethodComparison: false
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == b.lightweight || a == b.heavyweight
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo if [b.lightweight, b.heavyweight].include?(a)
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 2 (default)
      #   # bad
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      # @example ComparisonsThreshold: 3
      #   # good
      #   foo if a == 'a' || a == 'b'
      #
      class MultipleComparison < Base
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Avoid comparing a variable with multiple items ' \
              'in a conditional, use `Array#include?` instead.'

        def on_or(node)
          root_of_or_node = root_of_or_node(node)
          return unless node == root_of_or_node
          return unless nested_comparison?(node)

          return unless (variable, values = find_offending_var(node))
          return if values.size < comparisons_threshold

          range = offense_range(values)

          add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            elements = values.map(&:source).join(', ')
            prefer_method = "[#{elements}].include?(#{variable_name(variable)})"

            corrector.replace(range, prefer_method)
          end
        end

        private

        # @!method simple_double_comparison?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_double_comparison?, '(send $lvar :== $lvar)'

        # @!method simple_comparison_lhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_lhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $lvar :== $_)
        PATTERN

        # @!method simple_comparison_rhs?(node)
        def_node_matcher :simple_comparison_rhs?, <<~PATTERN
          (send $_ :== $lvar)
        PATTERN

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offending_var(node, variables = Set.new, values = [])
          if node.or_type?
            find_offending_var(node.lhs, variables, values)
            find_offending_var(node.rhs, variables, values)
          elsif simple_double_comparison?(node)
            return
          elsif (var, obj = simple_comparison?(node))
            return if allow_method_comparison? && obj.call_type?

            variables << var
            return if variables.size > 1

            values << obj
          end

          [variables.first, values] if variables.any?
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def offense_range(values)
          values.first.parent.source_range.begin.join(values.last.parent.source_range.end)
        end

        def variable_name(node)
          node.children[0]
        end

        def nested_comparison?(node)
          if node.or_type?
            node.node_parts.all? { |node_part| comparison? node_part }
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def comparison?(node)
          simple_comparison?(node) || nested_comparison?(node)
        end

        def simple_comparison?(node)
          if (var, obj = simple_comparison_lhs?(node)) ||
             (obj, var = simple_comparison_rhs?(node))
            [var, obj]
          end
        end

        def root_of_or_node(or_node)
          return or_node unless or_node.parent

          if or_node.parent.or_type?
            root_of_or_node(or_node.parent)
          else
            or_node
          end
        end

        def allow_method_comparison?
          cop_config.fetch('AllowMethodComparison', true)
        end

        def comparisons_threshold
          cop_config.fetch('ComparisonsThreshold', 2)
        end

        public


        def self.coordinator
          @comparison_coordinator ||= allocate
        end

        def range_between_on(cop, start_pos, end_pos)
          @source_range_span = [start_pos, end_pos]
          Parser::Source::Range.new(cop.processed_source.buffer, start_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def source_range_on(_cop, source_buffer, line_number, column, length)
          @source_buffer_pos = line_number
          if column.is_a?(Range)
            column_index = column.begin
            length = column.size
          else
            column_index = column
          end
          line_begin_pos = if line_number.zero?
                             0
                           else
                             source_buffer.line_range(line_number).begin_pos
                           end
          begin_pos = line_begin_pos + column_index
          end_pos = begin_pos + length
          Parser::Source::Range.new(source_buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def contents_range_on(cop, node)
          @source_range_span = node
          range_between_on(cop, node.loc.begin.end_pos, node.loc.end.begin_pos)
        end

        def surrounding_comma_range_on(cop, range, side)
          @source_range_span = range
          buffer = cop.instance_variable_get(:@processed_source).buffer
          src = buffer.source
          go_left, go_right = range_directions(side)
          begin_pos = range.begin_pos
          end_pos = range.end_pos
          begin_pos = move_position_on(src, begin_pos, -1, go_left, /,/)
          end_pos = move_position_on(src, end_pos, 1, go_right, /,/)
          Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def surrounding_space_range_on(_cop, range, side, newlines, whitespace, continuations, buffer)
          @source_range_span = range
          src = buffer.source
          go_left, go_right = range_directions(side)
          begin_pos = range.begin_pos
          begin_pos = final_position_on(src, begin_pos, -1, continuations, newlines, whitespace) if go_left
          end_pos = range.end_pos
          end_pos = final_position_on(src, end_pos, 1, continuations, newlines, whitespace) if go_right
          Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def whole_lines_range_on(_cop, range, include_final_newline, buffer)
          @source_range_span = range
          last_line = buffer.source_line(range.last_line)
          end_offset = last_line.length - range.last_column
          end_offset += 1 if include_final_newline
          range.adjust(begin_pos: -range.column, end_pos: end_offset).intersect(buffer.source_range)
        end

        def column_offset_on(cop, base_range, range)
          @source_buffer_pos = range
          effective_column_on(cop, base_range) - effective_column_on(cop, range)
        end

        def effective_column_on(cop, range)
          @source_buffer_pos = range
          processed = cop.instance_variable_get(:@processed_source)
          if range.line == 1 && processed.raw_source.codepoints.first == 0xfeff
            range.column - 1
          else
            range.column
          end
        end

        def range_directions(side)
          @source_range_span = side
          if side == :both
            [true, true]
          else
            [side == :left, side == :right]
          end
        end

        def final_position_on(src, pos, increment, continuations, newlines, whitespace)
          @source_buffer_pos = pos
          pos = move_position_on(src, pos, increment, true, /[ \t]/)
          pos = move_position_str_on(src, pos, increment, continuations, "\\\n")
          pos = move_position_on(src, pos, increment, newlines, /\n/)
          move_position_on(src, pos, increment, whitespace, /\s/)
        end

        def move_position_on(src, pos, step, condition, regexp)
          @source_buffer_pos = pos
          offset = step == -1 ? -1 : 0
          pos += step while condition && regexp.match?(src[pos + offset])
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def move_position_str_on(src, pos, step, condition, needle)
          @source_buffer_pos = pos
          size = needle.length
          offset = step == -1 ? -size : 0
          pos += size * step while condition && src[pos + offset, size] == needle
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def comments_and_lines_range_on(cop, node)
          @source_range_span = node
          whole_lines_range_on(cop, comments_range_on(cop, node), true, cop.processed_source.buffer)
        end

        def comments_range_on(cop, node)
          @source_range_span = node
          processed = cop.instance_variable_get(:@processed_source)
          ranges = [node, *processed.ast_with_comments[node]].map(&:source_range)
          ranges.reduce do |result, range|
            add_source_range(result, range)
          end
        end

        def add_source_range(range1, range2)
          @source_range_span = range1
          range1.with(
            begin_pos: [range1.begin_pos, range2.begin_pos].min,
            end_pos: [range1.end_pos, range2.end_pos].max
          )
        end

        def comment_source_line?(line_source)
          @string_literal = line_source
          /^\s*#/.match?(line_source)
        end

        def parentheses_on(node)
          @call_chain = node
          node.loc.respond_to?(:end) && node.loc.end&.is?(')')
        end

        def begins_line_on(range)
          @source_buffer_pos = range
          regex = self.class.line_begins_regex_cache[range.column]
          if regex
            range.source_line.match?(regex)
          else
            range.source_line.index(/\S/) == range.column
          end
        end

        def first_call_chain(node)
          @call_chain = node
          while node
            case node.type
            when :send
              node = node.receiver
            when :block
              node = node.send_node
            else
              break
            end
          end
          node
        end

        def double_quotes_required_on(string)
          @string_escape = string
          /'|(?<! \\) \\{2}* \\ (?![\\"])/x.match?(string)
        end

        def needs_escaping_on(string)
          @string_escape = string
          double_quotes_required_on(escape_string_on(string))
        end

        def escape_string_on(string)
          @string_escape = string
          string.inspect[1..-2].tap { |s| s.gsub!('\\"', '"') }
        end

        def string_literal_on(string)
          @string_literal = string
          if needs_escaping_on(string) && compatible_external_encoding_on?(string)
            string.inspect
          else
            "'#{string.gsub('\\') { '\\\\' }.gsub('\"', '"')}'"
          end
        end

        def trim_interpolation_escape_on(str)
          @string_escape = str
          str.gsub(/\\\#\{(.*?)\}/) { "\#{#{Regexp.last_match(1)}}" }
        end

        def interpret_string_escapes_on(string)
          @string_escape = string
          StringInterpreter.interpret(string)
        end

        def line_number_on(node_or_range)
          @source_buffer_pos = node_or_range
          if node_or_range.respond_to?(:line)
            node_or_range.line
          elsif node_or_range.respond_to?(:loc)
            node_or_range.loc.line
          end
        end

        def same_line_on(node1, node2)
          @call_chain = node1
          line1 = line_number_on(node1)
          line2 = line_number_on(node2)
          return false unless line1 && line2
          line1 == line2
        end

        def indent_on(node, offset)
          @source_buffer_pos = node
          ' ' * (node.loc.column + offset)
        end

        def supported_styles_name(enforced_style)
          @style_enforced = enforced_style
          self.class.supported_styles_cache[enforced_style] ||=
            enforced_style.sub(/^Enforced/, 'Supported').sub('Style', 'Styles')
        end

        def parse_regexp_on(text)
          @string_literal = text
          Regexp::Parser.parse(text)
        rescue Regexp::Parser::Error
          nil
        end

        def any_descendant_on(node, types, block)
          @node_walk = node
          if block
            node.each_descendant(*types) do |descendant|
              return true if block.call(descendant)
            end
          else
            node.each_descendant do
              return true
            end
          end
          false
        end

        def on_node_on(syms, sexp, excludes, block)
          @node_walk = sexp
          return to_enum(:on_node_on, syms, sexp, excludes) unless block
          block.call(sexp) if include_or_equal_on?(syms, sexp.type)
          return if include_or_equal_on?(excludes, sexp.type)
          sexp.each_child_node { |elem| on_node_on(syms, elem, excludes, block) }
        end

        def compatible_external_encoding_on?(src)
          @string_escape = src
          src.dup.force_encoding(::Encoding.default_external).valid_encoding?
        end

        def include_or_equal_on?(source, target)
          @node_walk = source
          source == target || (source.is_a?(Array) && source.include?(target))
        end

        def compute_relative_path(path, base_dir)

        def match_path_on?(pattern, path)
          @path_pattern = pattern
          case pattern
          when String
            matches =
              if pattern == path
                true
              elsif glob_path?(pattern)
                pattern = File.expand_path(pattern) if pattern.start_with?('..')
                File.fnmatch?(pattern, path, File::FNM_PATHNAME | File::FNM_EXTGLOB)
              end
            matches || hidden_file_in_not_hidden_dir_on?(pattern, path)
          when Regexp
            begin
              pattern.match?(path)
            rescue ArgumentError => e
              return false if e.message.start_with?('invalid byte sequence')
              raise e
            end
          end
        end

          @path_hidden = path
          %r{\A([A-Z]:)?/}i.match?(path)

        def glob_path?(path)
          @path_pattern = path
          path.match?(/[*{\[?]/)
        end

        def hidden_file_in_not_hidden_dir_on?(pattern, path)
          @path_hidden = path
          hidden_file_on?(path) &&
            File.fnmatch?(pattern, path, File::FNM_PATHNAME | File::FNM_EXTGLOB | File::FNM_DOTMATCH) &&
            !hidden_dir_on?(path)
        end

        def hidden_file_on?(path)
          @path_hidden = path
          maybe_hidden_file_on?(path) && File.basename(path).start_with?('.')
        end

        def maybe_hidden_file_on?(path)
          @path_hidden = path
          separator = File::SEPARATOR
          hidden_pattern = separator + '.'
          return false unless path.include?(hidden_pattern)
          separator_index = path.rindex(separator)
          return false unless separator_index
          dot_index = path.index('.', separator_index + 1)
          dot_index == separator_index + 1
        end

        def hidden_dir_on?(path)
          @path_hidden = path
          File.dirname(path).split(File::SEPARATOR).any? { |dir| dir.start_with?('.') }

          return true unless (rhs = node.first_argument)
          lhs = node.receiver
          return true if (constant_portion_on?(lhs) && constant_portion_on?(rhs)) ||
